SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT DOC_NAME , TARGET AS TARGET , KEY_1 AS KEY_1 , KEY_2 AS KEY_2 FROM APPS.KEPTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'PO' AND IF_FLAG = 'N' AND ROWNUM < 6 ORDER BY DOC_NAME, KEY_1, KEY_2
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'SMT2' AS BUYER , 'KA' AS SITE , '$G_RS.TARGET$' AS PLANT , LEGACY_PO_NO , LEGACY_PO_SEQ , DECODE(STATUS,'APPROVED','C','D') AS STATUS , BUYER_ITEM_NO , UNIT_PRICE , ITEM_QTY , ITEM_AMT , TO_CHAR(APPROVED_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS ADD_DATE , TO_CHAR(RD_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS RD_DATE , '$G_RS.TARGET$' AS DELY_TO_LOCATION , DELY_TO_LOCATION AS DELY_TO_LOCATION_TEXT , PURCHASER_USER_ID , LEGACY_PR_NO , REQ_USER_NUMBER AS REQ_USER_ID , REQ_USER_NAME , REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME , REQ_USER_PHON || '^' || REQ_USER_EMAIL AS REQ_USER_INFO , PURCHASER_USER_NAME ||'^'|| PO_HEADER_ID ||'^'|| PO_LINE_ID ||'^'|| LINE_LOCATION_ID ||'^'|| VENDOR_ID ||'^'|| DELY_TO_LOCATION ||'^'|| REQ_USER_NAME AS IV_COLUMN FROM APPS.V_KEP_PO WHERE 1=1 /* AND PLANT = '$G_RS.TARGET$' */ AND LEGACY_PO_NO = '$G_RS.KEY_1$' AND LEGACY_PO_SEQ = $G_RS.KEY_2$ ORDER BY PLANT, LEGACY_PO_NO, LEGACY_PO_SEQ
UPDATE APPS.KEPTRXL SET KEY_6 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') , IF_FLAG = 'Y' WHERE DOC_NAME = '$G_RS.DOC_NAME$' AND TARGET = '$G_RS.TARGET$' AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.KEY_1$' AND KEY_2 = '$G_RS.KEY_2$' AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
